method: Every capability claim on the deck is drawn from _raw/merged-register.json "features" status (WORKING/VERIFIED WORKING -> Available now, PARTIALLY WORKING/CONFIGURATION DEPENDENT/INCOMPLETE -> In development, NOT IMPLEMENTED/PLACEHOLDER/NOT VERIFIED -> Planned or omitted) and cross-checked against _raw/final-decision.json and _raw/verification-and-review.json for any EV that changes a status. Claims tied to a false/removed marketing claim in the audit (e.g. payment custody, TDS) are explicitly omitted from the deck rather than shown as Planned.

claims.claim_text: Creator campaigns commonly run on spreadsheets/WhatsApp/email with no shared record, manual creator discovery, and payment as a trust exercise.
claims.status_on_slide: context (industry framing, not a product capability claim)
claims.notes: General market-problem framing echoing Influora's own honest homepage copy ("Influora replaces the spreadsheet-WhatsApp-invoice mess"). No customer counts, revenue, or market-size figures invented, per merged-register feature "Honest, non-fabricated homepage proof points" (VERIFIED WORKING, E5/C88).

claims.claim_text: Brands can browse and shortlist creators in a marketplace (apply/detail flows).
claims.notes: merged-register.json features: "Creator marketplace browse/detail/apply" = WORKING, E4/C85.

claims.claim_text: Brands and creators brief, chat and track deliverables in a per-deal room.
claims.notes: features: "Deal-room messaging incl. SSE stream" = WORKING E4/C90; "Creator deliverables: list/bulk/upload/status/submit/metrics/proof/mark-posted/verify" = WORKING E5/C90.

claims.claim_text: Campaign funds are held in the brand's Influora wallet and released to the creator after approval.
claims.notes: features: "Escrow funding" = PARTIALLY WORKING E5/C77, related_ev EV-002 (re-funding a funded/released milestone can double-debit — verified by verification-and-review.json). The approval→release step itself is WORKING (E5/C83, EV-019/EV-021) and is called out separately on the Payments & Trust slide.

claims.claim_text: Brand sign-up (email OTP) and KYC verification.
claims.notes: features: "Brand email-OTP signup/verify/register/login" PARTIALLY WORKING E3/C70; "Brand onboarding + KYC" PARTIALLY WORKING E5/C79, related EV-016 (admins cannot view uploaded KYC docs / are not notified).

claims.claim_text: Creator discovery/search and filtering.
claims.notes: features: "Creator discovery" PARTIALLY WORKING E4/C70 (marketplace browse/apply itself is WORKING and shown on Slide 3/5).

claims.notes: features: "Campaign CRUD / publish" PARTIALLY WORKING E5/C72 (EV-005: create() can reach ACTIVE without the funding/fee gate that update() enforces); "Escrow funding" PARTIALLY WORKING E5/C77 (EV-002).

Note: final-decision.json flags a role-gate gap (EV-021) on who can trigger approval, masked today only because release itself was not yet auto-wired (EV-019); this is a backend authorization hardening item, tracked for fix, not shown on the customer-facing slide.

claims.claim_text: Influora facilitates payments; it is not a licensed payment aggregator and does not claim custody of funds.
claims.notes: final-decision.json: EV-007 (P0) found live copy falsely claiming an RBI-authorized PA holds funds and "never pools", while code pools funds in an Influora-owned wallet; XR-ROHAN-01 flags an unconditional "Guaranteed payment" claim. Required action: remove custody/RBI-PA/guaranteed claims and replace with a factual facilitator description — this slide follows that instruction and the standing rule that "escrow" and custody-license language are banned from brand/creator-facing copy (F-0851).

claims.claim_text: Meera's tools are scoped and cannot move money directly; write actions run on an on-behalf, reviewed token.
claims.notes: features: "Money-tool exclusion + on-behalf scoped token" VERIFIED WORKING E4/C85; "Meera tool schemas (Anthropic-valid, no combinators)" VERIFIED WORKING E4/C90; "Prompt-injection isolation" VERIFIED WORKING E3/C75. Note: the deck deliberately does not claim Meera can launch or fund a campaign end-to-end — "Meera confirm_launch / AI campaign launch" is CONFIGURATION DEPENDENT (E3/C69) and a related funding link is flagged broken in final-decision.json (EV-024), so that capability is intentionally omitted rather than shown as available.

claims.claim_text: No subscription cost on the Free tier.
claims.notes: Confirmed live in src/pages/pricing.tsx (₹0 tier, "no subscription on Free"). merged-register EV-100 (P2) flags that this figure is hand-duplicated across 3 files with no automated sync check — shown here as the currently documented/coded figure, not independently re-verified at runtime for this RC.

claims.claim_text: Discover/shortlist, deal room, deliverable tracking and dispute resolution are on Free.
claims.notes: Matches WORKING features already cited on Slides 3 & 5 (marketplace, deal room, deliverables, dispute resolution).

claims.claim_text: 10% platform fee on Free, 7% on Pro, charged when a campaign is published.
claims.notes: EV-087 (E2/C80, code-confirmed): BrandCampaignFeeService.chargeOnPublish uses default brand fee 1000 bps (10%), Pro plan override 700 bps (7%). EV-060 (P2, E3/C85) flags the fee is resolved from 4 divergent sources across the codebase (yml default 15%, DB seed 10%, PRO override, one FE hardcode of 15%) — presented here using the DB-seeded/plan rates that BrandCampaignFeeService actually charges, not the unused yml default; this inconsistency is a code-hygiene item for engineering, not shown on the slide.

claims.notes: Confirmed live in src/pages/pricing.tsx (price: 4999). Same EV-100 sync caveat as the Free tier price.

claims.claim_text: 400 AI credits/month and 5 team seats on Pro.
claims.notes: Confirmed live in src/pages/pricing.tsx copy ("400 AI credits a month", "5 team seats"). Same EV-100 caveat.

claims.claim_text: Brands can subscribe/upgrade to Pro themselves.
claims.notes: features: "Subscription billing" PARTIALLY WORKING E3/C58.

claims.claim_text: Not claimed on this deck.
claims.notes: The live pricing/FAQ copy currently states "TDS shown on payouts," but final-decision.json EV-031 (P1) found no TDS computation on the automated payout path and no Form 16A code; merged-register lists "TDS on creator payouts" as NOT IMPLEMENTED. Per the CEO decision this claim must be removed from customer-facing copy, so it is intentionally left off this deck rather than labelled Planned.
